claims: VCU was the No. 11 seed in the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
North Carolina was the No. 6 seed in the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
VCU defeated North Carolina 82-78 in overtime in the first round of the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
The game was at Bon Secours Wellness Arena, Greenville, S.C.
VCU's comeback marks the sixth-largest comeback in tournament history.
Terrence Hill Jr. scored 34 points for VCU.
VCU trailed by 19 points (56-37) with 13:50 remaining in regulation.
Terrence Hill Jr. made 7-of-10 from 3-point range.
VCU had a 12-0 run to start the comeback.
This marked the first time in UNC history that the team was eliminated in the first round in back-to-back years.
VCU advances to play the winner of #3 Illinois/#14 Penn in the second round.
This was VCU's first NCAA tournament win since 2016
